newsitem.title: SOUTH AFRICA: Benco, Moonstone gems see high bids.
newsitem.headline: Benco, Moonstone gems see high bids.

text.p: Benco Ltd and Moonstone Diamond Corporation said on Wednesday that diamonds produced by their floating mine vessel, Moonstar, had attracted higher-than-forecast bids at their first auction.
The companies said in a statement that a parcel of diamonds weighing 2,908.79 carats realised $237.64 per carat -- 18 percent higher than the forecast $200.
"Perhaps more important was the makeup of the parcel with an average stone size of 0.34 carats," Benco chairman John Gurney said.
"This size, sought after by the jewellery trade, along with common marine diamond features of high quality and good shapes, contributed to the premium prices obtained.
"We are on track. Moonstone has completed her sea trials, is operationally sound and starting to pay her way."
The joint venture mining operation off the west coast of South Africa is in its first year of an initial five year agreement in concession areas 2(b) and 3(B) south of the Orange River.
It is expected that the 2,330 tonne floating mine would be able to recover up to 65,000 carats a year.
